(assert
  (forall ((x Int) (y Int))
    (=> (not (= y 0)) (= x (+ (* y (div1 x y)) (mod1 x y))))))

(assert
  (forall ((m (Array Int Int)) (p addr) (n Int))
    (=
      (valid_rw m p n)
      (=>
        (< 0 n)
        (and
          (< 0 (base p))
          (and (<= 0 (offset p)) (<= (+ (offset p) n) (select m (base p)))))))))

(assert
  (forall ((m (Array Int Int)) (p addr) (n Int))
    (=
      (valid_rd m p n)
      (=>
        (< 0 n)
        (and
          (not (= 0 (base p)))
          (and (<= 0 (offset p)) (<= (+ (offset p) n) (select m (base p)))))))))

(assert
  (forall ((p addr) (lp Int) (q addr) (lq Int))
    (=
      (included p lp q lq)
      (=>
        (< 0 lp)
        (and
          (<= 0 lq)
          (and
            (= (base p) (base q))
            (and
              (<= (offset q) (offset p))
              (<= (+ (offset p) lp) (+ (offset q) lq)))))))))

(assert
  (forall ((m (Array Int (Array Int Int))) (a addr) (v Int))
    (! (=> (is_uint64 v) (= (read_uint64 (write_uint64 m a v) a) v)) :pattern (
    (read_uint64
      (write_uint64 m a v)
      a)) )))

(assert
  (forall ((m (Array Int (Array Int Int))) (ar addr) (aw addr) (v Int))
    (! (=>
         (separated aw 8 ar 8)
         (= (read_uint64 (write_uint64 m aw v) ar) (read_uint64 m ar))) :pattern (
    (read_uint64
      (write_uint64 m aw v)
      ar)) )))
